summary: AIM ImmunoTech filed an 8-K reporting conversion of $1,224,341 of its February 2024 promissory note with Streeterville Capital into 5,065,840 common shares at an average ~$0.24/share, extinguishing the note as of September 3, 2026. The exchanges occurred August 31–September 3, 2026, under exchange agreements and partitioned notes, with shares issued pursuant to Section 3(a)(9) exemption. Stockholders had approved the conversion on July 15, 2026 under NYSE American rules. No advisor or board recommendation. This is an equity issuance to satisfy debt—a capital return (deleveraging) via share issuance. Watch for dilution impact and lender's remaining holdings.
